name: batch
description: Run several independent tool operations in ONE call — multiple searches, multiple file searches/reads, or multiple app/script writes. Every result comes back in a single round-trip, each labeled [n/N]. Prefer this over calling tools one by one whenever you need several operations at once. Sub-calls use the same public tool names and parameters as normal calls. Never nest batch inside batch; keep dependent steps (e.g. write then edit the same file) as separate calls.

calls.description: up to 8 operations, run in order

arguments.description: that tool's parameters, same shape as a normal call

tool.description: public tool name, e.g. search, canvas, scripts

name: skills
description:
Manage Agent Skills from app, project, and user/global roots; create and install write only to the app-managed root.
- action=load: Read full skill instructions or a relative file. Needs name; optional file.
- action=create: Create a skill. Needs name, description; optional body, overwrite.
- action=install: Install a skill from GitHub. Needs source.

file.description: optional path within the skill for load; defaults to SKILL.md

name: scripts
description:
Manage confined space scripts, run skill or space scripts, and install packages.
- action=list: List space script files.
- action=read: Read a script with stable hash-lines. Needs path; optional offset, limit.
- action=write: Replace a script's complete content. Needs path, content.
- action=edit: Apply hash-line edits to a script. Needs path, edits.
- action=run: Run an existing skill or space script. Needs path; optional skill, space, args.
- action=python: Write and run Python in the space environment, persisting unless temporary=true. Needs code, name; optional temporary, args.
- action=install: Install packages into at most one skill or app target, defaulting to the space Python environment. Needs packages; optional skill, app.

edits.description: hash-line edits from the latest read

line.description: optional 1-based line number to disambiguate repeated lines

path.description: script path relative to the scripts dir

skill.description: skill name for run (unless space=true), or pip target for install

space.description: run from the space scripts directory

temporary.description: delete the script after python runs (default false)

name: canvas
description:
Draft writing as a doc (Markdown), presentations as a deck. Space files: docs/*.doc.json or decks/*.deck.json; kind from path or create.kind (default deck). Decks: choose the look first (design op=list, create.design); build slides with add_slide{layout,slots,after?}; use color roles and named styles; fix taste: and design: lines. Edit directly when asked, comment when reviewing or unsure. One file per request: edit it, no variants or probes. Never invent data, sources or images (src: https or space file). Decks: /studio, 1920x1080 px, auto-layout; view after layout changes. Docs: read outline or blocks; view pages; export docx/pdf/md/html. Atomic ops; ids/hashes automatic. Field references arrive with results. Comments: anchor to a block; one issue, two sentences with why; attach ops for fixes; at most 8, worst first; respect intent and facts; answer the thread.
- action=create: Create.
- action=read: Outline/tree, revision, threads. Needs path.
- action=view: Deck slides: studio focus or sheet. Needs path.
- action=fonts: Deck and installed families. Needs path.
- action=edit: Apply ops; shows changed slides. Needs path, ops.
- action=comment: Pin a comment (ops optional) or reply. Needs path, text.
- action=resolve: Resolve a comment thread. Needs path, thread.
- action=history: List or restore earlier versions. Needs path.
- action=export: Save a file in exports/. Needs path.
- action=design: Designs and layouts. Needs op.

from.description: space file: create source; design import: template

patch.description: merge patch: colors, fonts, font_files, scale, slide/doc.text_styles

slides.description: create: slide objects; read, view: ids or numbers

template.description: export: none for a plain file

text.description: comment; fonts filter; legacy export format

name: search
description:
Search general web sources, recent reporting (web with recency), papers, or Reddit and Hacker News threads (discussion: opinions, experiences, recommendations, comparisons, troubleshooting).
- mode=web: Search general sources; use recency for recent news reporting. Needs query; optional recency, include_domains, exclude_domains.
- mode=academic: Search academic papers with Semantic Scholar, preserving scholarly metadata. Needs query; optional limit.
- mode=discussion: Reddit and Hacker News threads; fetch_url a thread to read its comments. Needs query.
- mode=images: Direct picture URLs for cards and replies; copy one exactly into image/src. Needs query.
- mode=chats: Earlier chats the user refers to; fetch_url a hit's chat: URL. Needs query; optional limit.

exclude_domains.description: exclude these domains from web results

include_domains.description: restrict web results to these domains

name: fetch_url
description:
Fetch readable, paged text from URLs, chat: URLs, PDFs, or YouTube transcripts, using the 24-hour cache and respecting verifier cache-only mode.
- fetch_url: Fetch a page of text. Needs url; optional offset, limit, fresh.

name: media
description:
Generate images/video; transform video locally with ffmpeg; save named image references for video consistency.
- action=generate_image: Generate image. Needs prompt.
- action=generate_video: Generate video with frame or named references. Needs prompt.
- action=edit: Transform video. Needs video_id.
- action=extract_frame: Extract frame. Needs video_id.
- action=stitch: Concatenate clips in order. Needs video_ids.
- action=save_reference: Save reference. Needs name, image_id, description.
- action=list_references: List references.
- action=delete_reference: Delete reference. Needs name.
